notes.title: 2024.9.20 早10点更新预计20分钟
notes.content:
Updated at 10am on September 20, 2024, expected to take 20 minutes
1. Ultimate Slayer: Critical Strike Increases Attack Speed by 15 Points
2. Sword Qi Lingyun: deals magic damage with an attack power of 150%
3. Deadly Guardian: Defeat once, deduct health, cool down for 4 rounds, and fail after resisting 3 times
4. There will be no banned schools of mind techniques now
5. Soul Stealing Pulse: Healing/Damage Increases to 24/36/48/60
6. Turning stones into gold: cooling 90/56/28/20
7. Immortal Golden Body: 300->200 layers, and restore golden light layers * 200% health
8. The arrival of the demon god: 200->100 layers, 200 attack speed ->100 attack speed, lasting for 5 seconds
9. Fix the bug of not providing runes for self selected runes
10. Ten thousand methods can now unlock gold cards by meeting 9 6/12 requirements

notes.title: 9.15 9~12am updates, adding a new cardiac system
notes.content:
New content:
1. Add a mental health system to encourage players to explore more game tricks

Adventure adjustment:
Life protection: withstand maximum damage 3->2
Gold scattered: restore 10 points of life, restore 1 point for every 200 gold coins
Winning streak/losing streak maniac: upper limit changed to 800

notes.title: 8.30 10 am Fix
notes.content:
Server maintenance on August 30, 2024 at 10am, expected to last for 2 hours
Game balance adjustment
1. The body of the demon god is changed from every 300 lives on 8/12/16/20 to every 400 lives on 10/15/25/25
2. The body of gold has changed from 8/12/16/20 for every 300 lives to 10/15/25/25 for every 400 lives
3. The Soul Stealing Pulse has been changed from 150 per cumulative charge to 200
4. The damage to humans caused by the pressure of nobility has been reduced to 0.5%, and the damage to wild monsters has been reduced to 1.5%, with a range of 900
5. Fury genre increases state resistance by up to 50%
6. The burst of magic energy has been changed from 80% 120% 160% 200% to a fixed 200+40%/60%/80%/100%
The next major version update will be available soon.

notes.title: 8.17 updates
notes.content:
2024.8.17
1. The economy of the small monster will decrease by 5->4, and the health of the small monster will decrease in the early stage (to balance the slow weapons of jungle)
2. Bounty Hunter reduced to 8/16/24/32
3. Turning stones into gold CD lowered to 90/56/28/18S
4. Qiankun's damage is reduced to 0.8%, 1.2%, 1.6%, and 2.4%
5. Fixed the bug where the state resistance was not effective
6. Fixed the bug where the first level of magic energy burst was not triggered. When magic energy comes, it will refresh the magic energy burst once
7. New genres updated to match

notes.title: Three new schools have been introduced: Immortal Magic, Golden Light, and Demon
notes.content:
8.15 updates
1. Add three new schools: Magic Qi, Golden Light, and Immortal Magic (only available in custom rooms for now)
2. Add the room recruitment function and fix the BUG of the card room
3. You can no longer join a room that has already started
4. Fix the bug of the double-sword Aoyu, and increase the range of the Aoyu by 70
5. Modify the damage of the fortune move from 1% to 0.8%
6. Increase the probability of obtaining a Gold Card by 50% at level 30 in the genre
7. Increase the initial gold coins from 800 to 1200, and change the basic damage increase from every 6 rounds to every 5 rounds, with an additional 2 points added every round after 24 rounds
8. Gifts of Liberation removes the guaranteed hit effect (effect is repeated)
9. Add the function of loudspeaker barrage
